description: Review rubric for structured formula_record entries (formula library).

criteria.label: LaTeX expression correctness
criteria.description: LaTeX renders correctly. Variables match standard symbols. Subscripts/superscripts in the right places.

criteria.label: Plain-English statement clarity
criteria.description: The plain-English statement matches the LaTeX exactly. Variable meanings are explicit.

criteria.label: Applicability conditions completeness
criteria.description: All conditions for the formula to apply are listed. Common student misuses (forgetting one condition) are pre-empted.

criteria.label: Worked example quality
criteria.description: Example uses realistic numbers, shows substitution + result. Brief but complete.

criteria.label: Dimensional consistency check
criteria.description: (Physics + Chem) Dimensional check is correct and confirms the formula. (Maths) Can be marked N/A.

approval_rule: latex_correctness MUST be 5/5. dimensional_check 'N/A' for Maths formulas is acceptable.
